title: melodic — lethargy

sentences.sentence: Their music is loud and not very melodic.
sentences.translation: 他们的音乐很响，而且不大悦耳。

sentences.sentence: The city of Madrid soon plans to add a striking new structure that will “climatically transform” its urban architecture.
sentences.translation: 马德里市区计划修建一座醒目的建筑，此建筑还将在气候上改变城市的建筑格局。

sentences.sentence: The cat became lethargic and had trouble breathing.
sentences.translation: 这只猫整天昏睡而且呼吸困难。

sentences.sentence: The koala seemed to be asleep, and I wondered for the first time just how one went about startling such a lethargic creature.
sentences.translation: 那只树熊似乎睡着了。 第一次干这活儿，我真不知怎么去惊吓一只昏睡的动物。

sentences.sentence: The organisers say they are also considering giving a prize to the slowest cell, since lethargic cells would be a boon for cancer therapy.
sentences.translation: 主办方表示他们也在考虑颁一个奖给速度最慢的细胞，因为这种昏睡细胞也是癌症治疗的福音。

sentences.sentence: According to the scientific team, only one of these four categories of gamblers actually shows signs of a significant pathology.
sentences.translation: 根据科学小组得知，事实上在这四种赌徒里只有一种显示出明显的病理学的迹象。

sentences.sentence: It makes sense to leave the ovaries if there is no risk factors or pathology at the time of surgery, especially in young women since those are the ones who seem to be most affected.
sentences.translation: 斯科西亚说，“如果在手术时没有出现危险因素或病理原因，那么保留卵巢就是合理的，尤其是那些年轻妇女，因为她们似乎是受到影响最大的人群。”

sentences.sentence: His remarks deeply offended many Scottish people.
sentences.translation: 他的话严重冒犯了许多苏格兰人。

sentences.sentence: Matter, energy and dark energy all produce curvature in space-time, however.
sentences.translation: 而事实上，物质、能量和暗能量在时空中都会产生弯曲。

sentences.sentence: The hyperbolic surface, which has so-called negative curvature because its surface curves up and down at the same time, like a saddle, just might represent the shape of the universe.
sentences.translation: 双曲表面，即通常所称的负曲率，因为它的表面曲线同时有的向上和有的向下，像一个马鞍，也许这样就可以代表宇宙的形状。

sentences.sentence: Then, with a few assumptions about the curvature and contents of the universe, they can reconstruct the positions of those objects from redshifts.
sentences.translation: 然后，通过一些关于宇宙曲率和内容的假设，科学家们能够重建这些物体的位置。

sentences.sentence: But is there an endpoint?
sentences.translation: 但是这是否有一个终点？

sentences.translation: 对于本教程，我们仅有一个端点。

sentences.translation: 然后，我在 WSDL 实现中收集服务和端口，该实现为这个绑定提供一个端点。

sentences.sentence: When my play was with thee I never questioned who thou wert. I knew nor shyness nor fear, my life was boisterous.
sentences.translation: 当我是同你做游戏的时候，我从来没有问过你是谁．我不懂得羞怯和惧怕，我的生活是热闹的．

melodic
音标：英 /mɪ'lɒdɪk/  美 /mə'lɑdɪk/

n. 病理学

curvature
音标：英 /'kɜːvətʃə/  美 /'kɝvətʃɚ/
